01.r: Opens the exception for the poor.

02.r: He has not the means to pay the set price.
02.n: Gesenius: to pine away, specially to be brought to poverty; BDB: be low, depressed, grow poor. The verb is rare.

03.r: The one who made the vow.
03.n: The pronoun is written out; the BSB names him, 'the one making the vow'.

04.r: The fixed price is more than he can pay.
04.n: Literally 'from your valuation': the Hebrew 'from' here makes a comparison, poorer than the valuation. 'Valuation' is the same word as in the scale of prices before this verse.
t: and not able to pay the estimation

05.r: The person vowed is brought to stand before the priest.
05.n: A causative form with 'and', future in sense: literally 'and he shall make him stand'. Who sets whom is not spelled out; a reasonable reading is that the one who vowed brings the person vowed, as the BSB takes it. The KJV and YLT make it reflexive, 'present himself', and the JPS and ASV passive, 'be set'.
t: he is to present the person

07.r: The priest who sets the price.

08.r: The priest fixes a lower price.
08.n: The verb from which 'valuation' comes. BDB gives this form as 'value', the brief's lexicon 'to value, tax'; Gesenius gives the root's first sense as TO ARRANGE IN ORDER. A perfect with 'and', future in sense; the Hebrew order is 'and shall value him the priest'.
t: and as much as he shall value

09.n: The object marker with 'him' joined to it.

11.n: Literally 'upon'; with the next word it forms 'upon the mouth of', meaning 'according to'.

12.r: The new price follows what he can afford.
12.n: Literally 'mouth': 'upon the mouth of' is a Hebrew phrase for 'according to'. STEP tags it here with the sense 'according, proportion'.

13.r: Introduces the measure of his means.

14.r: What his means will stretch to.
14.n: Gesenius gives this form as to reach, to attain unto; BDB adds that with 'hand' it means one is able, or has enough. 'His hand can reach' is the Hebrew picture for 'he can afford'.
t: and see him able to pay

15.r: The vower's means, pictured as his reach.
15.n: STEP tags the word here with a special sense, 'expend, (reach) hand', used in this idiom.

s: the one who made the vow
16.r: The man who made the vow.
16.n: A participle with the article: 'the vowing one'. Gesenius gives the sense to vow, to promise voluntarily to do or to give anything.

17.r: The priest's price stands as the payment.
17.n: The same verb as earlier in the verse, now with 'him' attached.

18.r: The priest, who has the last word on the price.

04.n: τιμή, 'price, value': 'poor in respect of the price'.

05.n: Dictionary form supplied; the brief gives none. στήσεται, 'he shall stand'; the Douay-Rheims's 'he shall stand' agrees.

08.n: τιμάω, 'to set a price on, value', the verb of the noun τιμή.

14.n: ἰσχύω, 'to be strong, be able': 'as the hand of the one who vowed is able'.

16.n: Dictionary form supplied; the brief gives none. εὐξαμένου, 'of the one who vowed'.
